name: Proof Console
concept: A horizontal studio proof instrument has six numbered selector keys, a large copy-derived mechanism drawing, and six permanently readable statements below.
silhouette: full-width navy selector/instrument over a quiet 3-by-2 written evidence strip
focal_reason: The chosen illustration, while all six reasons remain visible
interaction: Click/touch, Arrow keys, Home, and End change only the drawing and its descriptive label. Buttons have pressed and focus states; without JavaScript the first drawing remains visible.
safety: The drawing is explicitly conceptual, not a live Hub or invented payment, approval, conversation, or search result. Both claim qualifications stay with their text.
